jobs.title: Part-Time Unarmed Security Officer — Public Safety & Patrol
jobs.description:
Marksman Security is seeking an Unarmed Security Officer to join our Fort Worth team. This role requires a valid Texas Level II Guard License, a current driver's license, and a willingness to work weekends, evenings, and holidays.

Pay is $16.00 per hour, with duties including patrolling public areas, maintaining visibility, and reporting incidents clearly. You'll work with a team under a leadership group that supports growth, emphasizes safety, and professional conduct.
